name: BanglaVariant-Explain
headline: Your variant.
description: Explore genetic variant records, trace the literature, and see what population data can—and cannot—tell us about South Asian research.
description_bn: Genetic variant-এর record ও গবেষণাপত্র পড়ুন। South Asian population data কোথায় আছে, কোথায় নেই—তা স্পষ্টভাবে দেখুন।
hero_note: Research and education only. Never a personal diagnosis.
hero_note_bn: শুধু গবেষণা ও শিক্ষা; ব্যক্তিগত diagnosis নয়।
orbit: Interpret the evidence. Respect the uncertainty.
section_title: From a variant to its context.
features: Find an exact supported identifier. Keep transcript, genome build and source classification together.
সঠিক identifier মিলিয়ে transcript, genome build ও source classification একসঙ্গে দেখুন।
Missing South Asian frequency stays missing. An ancestry label is not a nationality or a clinical conclusion.
South Asian frequency না থাকলে তা missing-ই থাকবে। Ancestry label মানেই nationality নয়।
Search licensed research abstracts and open the original publication. Keyword similarity is not proof.
গবেষণার abstract খুঁজে মূল paper খুলুন। Keyword match প্রমাণের নিশ্চয়তা নয়।
steps: Use a supported ClinVar ID, HGVS alias or exact VCF coordinate.
ClinVar ID, HGVS alias বা exact VCF coordinate ব্যবহার করুন।
Read the recorded classification and review status.
Recorded classification ও review status পড়ুন।
Check population availability and original literature.
Population data আছে কি না ও মূল paper দেখুন।
Export an evidence snapshot with its limits.
closing: Better questions begin with traceable evidence.
disclaimer: For research and education only, not medical advice. No validated pathogenicity prediction or Bangladesh-specific clinical performance is claimed.
disclaimer_bn: শুধু গবেষণা ও শিক্ষা। Medical advice নয়। Validated pathogenicity prediction বা Bangladesh-specific clinical performance দাবি করা হচ্ছে না।
auth_title: See the record. Understand the context.
dash_sub: Source-linked genomic evidence, without invented certainty.
dash_sub_bn: উৎসসহ genomic evidence, অযাচাইকৃত সিদ্ধান্ত ছাড়া।
